summary: Find the bounding box of every green 3 cell and use the sums of its top/bottom and left/right coordinates as doubled horizontal and vertical centers. Preserve every nonzero cell. For each empty cell, paint red 2 when its horizontal, vertical, or double reflection through those center axes is already red. This completes every red orbit under both reflections.
